messages:
ashley: FYI opened a PR to cut over the console observability samples to SDK v2. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2143 :clipboard:

ashley: Changed the dashboard example JSON, updated tracing hook snippets (node + python), and rewrote the cost/latency breakdown to reference the `token_units` metric. Preview: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2143 :eyes:

kevin: 👍 can someone check responsive rendering? last time the legend overflowed on small widths. :thinking_face:

maya: i'll run a quick responsive pass. also — did you preserve old metric keys to avoid breaking existing customers?

ashley: preserved backward-compatible metric keys. added a migration note about the new `cost_key` used by the breakdown widget.

samir: quick code note: node snippet still uses old `tracing.startSpan(...)` shape. should show new `Tracing.start('name', {attributes})`. i'll post a diff in the PR.

ashley: tagging you as reviewer @samir, thanks.

docs-bot: Automated check: broken links found -> /sdk/node/tracing. Redirect created in branch. Lint: 0 warnings. Preview build succeeded.

ryan: small legal nit: copy references "per-token cost" but billing uses `token_units`. pls keep terminology consistent for customer-facing docs.

olivia: will update copy to use `token_units` and add a footnote about rounding for display.

maya: responsive test: legend still wraps at 320px. two options: collapse legend into a toggle or place legend below chart. thoughts?

kevin: prefer toggle to keep density, but ensure keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.

ashley: toggle seems fine. @samir if you modify widget JSON can you add ARIA attributes?

samir: sure. plan to add something like: ```json
{"legend": {"position": "toggle", "ariaLabel": "Toggle legend"}}
```

kevin: also small readability tweak for python tracing example: use context manager style: ```python
with Tracing.span("handle_request") as span:
    span.set_attribute("route", "/generate")
    # ...
```

samir: merged snippet changes into branch and added ARIA attrs. tested locally.

docs-bot: Preview updated: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood.ai/2143 1 checks passing.

ashley: final checklist before merge: 1) accessibility 003 (samir) 2) responsive legend toggle 003 (maya) 3) copy uses `token_units` 003 (olivia + ryan) 4) examples use SDK v2 signatures 003 (samir + kevin) 5) redirects in place 003 (docs-bot)

maya: running e2e rendering tests on staging in ~10m and will report back here.

kevin: aim to merge today if staging looks good. :shipit:

maya: e2e pass on staging. found a tiny gap at 375px; fixed with a one-line CSS rule and pushed to PR.

ashley: awesome. merging after ryan sign-off. thanks all! :tada:

ryan: approved and merged. please monitor console metrics for 24h for any regressions in the cost widget.

ashley: will keep watch, and drafted a rollback plan in the PR notes in case we need to revert. thanks everyone.
